WFRP4E_SIM.SimNotes.Title: Sim Notes (fidelity disclosures)
WFRP4E_SIM.SimNotes.Intro: This simulator approximates several WFRP4e rules to keep iterations fast. Real combat at your table may diverge from these results when:
WFRP4E_SIM.SimNotes.Initiative: Initiative is a flat 1d10 + I + Ag bonus, not the WFRP4e opposed Initiative vs Cool test for surprise rounds.
WFRP4E_SIM.SimNotes.Conditions: Poisoned uses a flat 50% per stack instead of a real Toughness test; Ablaze damage is approximated as stacks+1 rather than 1d10.
WFRP4E_SIM.SimNotes.Miscasts: Miscasts fire on any double, with no consultation of the Minor/Major Miscast tables - the event is recorded but no follow-on effect is applied.
WFRP4E_SIM.SimNotes.Stances: Defensive, Aggressive, and Total Defence stance trade-offs are not modeled. Combatants either attack or defend; mid-attack stance choice is the AI's decision.
WFRP4E_SIM.SimNotes.SharedActors: When one actor is dropped into the sim multiple times, each entry rolls independently and Apply stacks the results sequentially onto the single source sheet.
WFRP4E_SIM.SimNotes.HitLocations: Hit-location bands use the static core table without weapon-quality reassignments (Hack, Impale).
WFRP4E_SIM.SimNotes.SkippedEffects: crit Active Effect change(s) couldn't be applied this sim - the sim still ran, but some crit consequences (rare custom-mode effects, unmapped paths) were dropped.
